summary.headline: Sky Gold Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 61% YoY to INR2,391 crore, with reported PAT of INR129 crore up 93% and H1 operating cash flow positive at INR136 crore.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of INR2,391 crore (up 61% YoY, up 18.8% QoQ), gross margin of 9.6% (up 133 bps YoY) and EBITDA of INR189.8 crore at a 7.9% margin. Reported PAT was INR129 crore after a INR7.35 crore exceptional charge for a fraud at subsidiary Star Mangalsutra; operational PAT was INR135 crore. H1 operating cash flow turned positive at INR136 crore versus an outflow of INR101 crore a year earlier, and net working capital fell to 55 days. Management declined to give forward guidance citing SEBI restrictions and referred to a recent fundraise without disclosing its purpose or size.

financial_highlights.change: +93% YoY; after INR7.35 crore exceptional fraud charge
vs outflow of INR101 crore in H1 FY26; 58% of H1 PAT
vs 59 days Mar-26, 63 days Sep-25, 71 days Mar-25

segments.name: Advance gold model
segments.commentary: Advance gold was 16% of business in Q2 FY27, ahead of the FY27 target of 15%; billing only making charges adds about 110 bps to gross margin with almost no working capital.

segments.name: Exports
segments.commentary: Q2 FY27 exports were INR435 crore, about 18% of business and roughly INR1,600 crore annualised; H1 FY27 exports were INR811 crore. FY23 exports were about INR35 crore.

segments.name: Studded / diamond jewellery
segments.commentary: Natural and lab-grown diamond jewellery is about 2.6% of Q2 revenue (management also cites 3% studded mix); diamond sequentially doubled its contribution and carries higher margin than company average.

segments.name: Mangalsutra (Star Mangalsutra, Shri Rishabh Gold)
segments.commentary: Rishabh Gold revenue grew from INR49 crore to INR175 crore and profit from INR1.6 crore to INR18.8 crore post acquisition at under INR10 crore; monthly volumes rose from about 20 kg to 150 kg. Star Mangalsutra had a INR10.70 crore fraud, of which INR3.35 crore was recovered.

segments.name: Uncut diamonds (Purvi Gems)
segments.commentary: Acquired at INR9 crore versus INR6 crore book value; management cites high margins and strong customer demand, with no separate financials disclosed.

guidance_outlook: Management said it cannot give forward guidance under SEBI rules; the latest presentation contains none.
Management said past targets remain on track: 5% to 5.25% PAT margin and 20% to 25% OCF-to-PAT conversion (H1 FY27 OCF was 58% of PAT).
Earlier targets referenced on the call: INR18,000 crore revenue by FY2030, INR945 crore PAT, and a net debt-free balance sheet by 2030.
After the fundraise mandate closes, management said it will revisit its numbers and may issue updated guidance.
Any gross margin improvement is to be redeployed into the business.
capex_capacity: Around 40 3D-printing paper-casting machines in operation; with direct casting, laser cutting and hologram stamping, jewellery is 20% to 30% lighter and gold loss cut from 1.5% to 0.5%.
Design team of around 180 people, up from 15-20 CAD designers at the 2018 listing.
Dubai international office started operations in September 2025 and serves GCC retailers and wholesalers.

Land monetisation: a buyer is in advanced due diligence; if no final commitment comes within 20-30 days, promoters will buy the land, timing previously stretched by about two months to avoid a related-party transaction.
Gold metal loan sanctioned at close to INR170 crore but not availed, as management does not find it PAT-accretive.
demand_pricing: Retailer customers include Kalyan, Senco and PN Gadgil, which listed recently and expanded showrooms rapidly; management says customers are consolidating supplier bases toward fewer, larger, well-capitalised manufacturers.
Karatage mix is shifting from 22-karat to 18-karat, 14-karat and 9-karat as gold prices rose sharply; management noted this shift is ongoing each quarter.
Margin gain in Q2 attributed to advance gold mix and studded mix; operating costs rose to 1.6% of sales from investment in CEO, design team and audit/finance functions.
Diamond credit of 90-120 days is market practice; diamond payables total about INR225 crore.
Receivable days were 33 at Sep-26 (39 at Sep-25, 26 at Mar-26), elevated by festive-season billing that collects in October-November.

qa_highlights.question: Can the company sustain about 5x-6x asset or inventory turns over the long term after the fundraise?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not give a turn target; it cited customer fundraising, store additions, exports and B2B consolidation, and said historical capital turn was close to six (as stated by the CFO), while declining forward guidance.

qa_highlights.question: Are the roughly INR400 crore of payables sustainable over the next six to twelve months?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed payables to diamond credit of about INR225 crore, bullion credit of about INR100 crore (around two days, from scale) and other raw material credit of about INR100 crore; said sustainability could not be commented on.

qa_highlights.question: Update on the proposed land monetisation and promoter commitment?
qa_highlights.answer: Mangesh Chauhan said a third-party buyer is in advanced due diligence; if no final commitment comes in 20-30 days, promoters will buy the land, with the deal stretched to avoid a related-party transaction.

qa_highlights.question: Could growth guidance be revised upward for FY28 after the fundraise?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the company has taken an enabling provision for the QIP; after the mandate closes it will revisit numbers and may return to the market with updated guidance.

qa_highlights.question: Is gold metal loan cost likely to rise with rate hikes?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said GML is available for 30-45 days under RBI norms, is not PAT-accretive, is currently not availed, and US rate pressure could raise GML borrowing rates.

qa_highlights.question: Are margins nearing saturation?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed about 25 bps QoQ improvement to advance gold volumes and studded mix; Mangesh Chauhan said margin guidance of 5-5.25% PAT remains on track and cited a 20-year journey of product expansion.

risks_watch: Trade payables rose to INR437 crore from INR92 crore in March 2026 and are concentrated in diamond credit; sustainability was not confirmed.
Star Mangalsutra fraud of INR10.70 crore, with INR7.35 crore written off as an exceptional item; recovery of the balance is unclear.
Inventory days rose to 39 from 37 in March 2026 as the studded mix grows, which needs more working capital.
Gold price volatility and karat downtrading; management says profitability is hedged back-to-back but gives no specific sensitivity.
Land monetisation is open, with a related-party transaction risk if the promoters buy the land.
Recent fundraise of around INR1,800 crore was referenced but its size, purpose and use of proceeds were not disclosed under SEBI rules.
summary.management_tone: Confident on past execution and margins, but guarded on forward-looking items, repeatedly deferring to SEBI restrictions on guidance, fundraise use of proceeds and festive-season outlook. The call included long narrative on history and Walmart analogy, with limited hard numbers on the fundraise.
key_quotes: Under SEBI guidelines, we are not supposed to give forward-looking guidance.
We converted 33% of TTM PAT into operating cash flow.
Gross margin is 9.6% this quarter, up 27 basis points over Q1.
Due to compliance restriction, we cannot comment on future guidance, but our past margin percentage guidance remains on track.

growth.why: Management withdrew all forward guidance citing SEBI rules, so there is no revenue growth number or delivery backing; the only reference is that past targets (5-5.25% PAT margin, 20-25% OCF-to-PAT) remain on track, while Q2 revenue grew 61% YoY and EBITDA 90% YoY with no capacity additions disclosed.

mgmt.note: Operating costs rose on investment in a CEO, but the brief gives no name, start date or growth plan for that appointment.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Gross margin rose to 9.6% (+133 bps YoY, +27 bps QoQ) on advance gold (16% of business vs 15% target) and studded mix; management says 5-5.25% PAT margin target remains on track versus Q2 operational PAT margin of 5.6%, though karat downtrading and gold volatility are risks.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: No new plant, line or store capacity was announced; the call cited about 40 3D-printing machines in operation and a Dubai office already live since September 2025.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Q2 revenue rose 61% YoY to INR2,391 crore and exports reached INR435 crore (about 18% of business), with customers consolidating supplier bases toward larger manufacturers; no volume guidance was given.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Management took an enabling provision for a QIP and said it will revisit numbers after the mandate closes; purpose and size of the recent ~INR1,800 crore fundraise were not disclosed, so any capex link is unconfirmed.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management declined forward guidance under SEBI rules but said it may issue updated guidance after the QIP mandate closes; H1 PAT was up 112% YoY, so the base is moving up.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Management says past targets (5-5.25% PAT margin, 20-25% OCF-to-PAT) remain on track, and H1 OCF was 58% of PAT, above the 20-25% target range.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Diamond jewellery is about 2.6% of Q2 revenue and roughly doubled sequentially with higher margins, but no specific new product launch date was given.

rows.label: Payables-funded working capital at risk
rows.why: Trade payables jumped to INR437 crore from INR92 crore in Mar-26, mostly diamond credit (~INR225 crore), and management would not confirm sustainability; net working capital days fell to 55 from 59.

rows.label: Land monetisation and promoter purchase
rows.why: A third-party buyer is in advanced due diligence; if no final commitment comes in 20-30 days, promoters will buy the land, which carries a related-party transaction risk.

rows.label: Net debt reduction
rows.why: Net debt fell to INR531 crore at Sep-26 from INR550 crore at Mar-26, and the gold metal loan of about INR170 crore is undrawn; the net debt-free by 2030 target is unchanged.

tone.note: Management was confident on margins and past execution but guarded on forward items, deferring to SEBI on guidance and fundraise use of proceeds; analysts pressed on payables sustainability, asset turns, and the fundraise.
